purpose: Reconstruct historical SH/SZ eligible A-share membership without survivor bias by combining the frozen current official A-share universe with frozen official delisting records.

interval_semantics.eligible_on_D: official_list_date <= D AND (official_delist_date is null OR D < official_delist_date)

scope.sse: Official STOCK_TYPE 1 Main A + 8 STAR only.
scope.szse_delisted: Official terminal-list table rows excluding records whose official security name explicitly identifies B/Ｂ share.
scope.prohibited: Do not infer exchange or board from ticker prefixes.

storage: One interval row per canonical security identity; do not materialize redundant date×security grids.
validation: current authority file hash must match V2.7.31 Final Record
SSE delisted Main A count=143 and STAR count=3
SZSE official terminal-list recordcount=208 across 11 pages
SZSE B-share exclusions must be explicitly name-labelled B/Ｂ and separately audited
2026-09-17 reconstructed set must equal frozen official set count=5221 and canonical-set SHA256=b9733a28f99a8c91902fb5ba7fb2fbc225a888bcc2cfa6c
current and delisted A-share identities must not form conflicting overlapping intervals
delist effective date and later are ineligible
intended_use: Historical technical research membership only. E-layer AI-Core eligibility remains a separate PIT evidence problem.
